title: Service health across observation windows
description: One status cell per service and window. Dot, exclamation, cross and question mark distinguish healthy, degraded, down and unavailable states alongside color.

props.name: data
props.description: One observation per declared serviceId/windowId pair. Status is healthy, degraded, down or null. Missing/invalid states are unavailable. Duplicate pairs and undeclared IDs reject the input.

props.name: services
props.description: Ordered services with unique, nonempty IDs and display labels.

props.name: windows
props.description: Ordered, equally spaced observation windows with unique, nonempty IDs and display labels.

props.name: label
props.description: Console header label; the surrounding gallery or application owns its page title.

props.name: source
props.description: Caller-supplied source text in the footer.

props.name: window
props.description: Caller-supplied aggregation window or snapshot context in the footer.

props.name: updated
props.description: Caller-supplied freshness text; the component never invents live status.

props.name: width
props.description: Optional total width in pixels; otherwise fills the container.

props.name: height
props.description: Optional total height in pixels. Dense plot content scrolls locally when constrained.

props.name: animate
props.description: Finite entrance animation using scoped motion tokens and the current reduced-motion preference.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional Tailwind utilities for the outer frame.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible description of this chart instance.
